messages.text:
"The core concept is a virtual pet presented with a retro interface, featuring five buttons at the bottom of the screen for interaction. There are 100 possible variations for your pet, determined by how you treat, care for, and interact with it. The pet will also evolve through five distinct stages—the fifth being the most challenging and time-consuming to reach, yet the most visually striking and impressive. Pets can be trained and pitted against those of other users in both online and offline PvP modes, with a global ranking system to track the most powerful pets. The ultimate goal is to create the definitive virtual pet. The game includes a variety of minigames and weekly quests to help you gain experience and earn equipable items—with a rare chance to obtain legendary gear. When you return to the game, the time that has elapsed since your last session is taken into account, and you will receive rewards accordingly.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
